collection.description: A patient's breathing grows shallow, and an inventor proposes a hand-operated device to move air into the lungs.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A patient's breathing becomes shallow after a sudden illness; an inventor proposes a hand-operated device to move air into the lungs.

choices.label: Try the untested device with permission.
Test the mechanism before using it on a patient.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient begins breathing more steadily, though the improvement may not last.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The device fails to help, and the patient dies despite the effort.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient recovers slowly over several days.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient grows weaker, and the family gathers at the bedside.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The inventor finds a flaw that could have caused harm.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The device becomes a teaching model rather than a proven treatment.
